description_en: Cancels multiple virus scan tasks that have not yet expired in a batch. After cancellation, terminals no longer pull and execute the tasks. Scans already running on terminals are not interrupted
description_zh: 批量取消尚未失效的即时病毒扫描任务。取消后终端不再拉取执行，已在终端运行的扫描不会中断
name: CancelVirusScanTasks

parameters.help_en: The collection of virus scan task IDs to cancel. The collection must contain at least one ID, and duplicate IDs are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 待取消的病毒扫描任务ID集合，至少包含1个，不允许重复
parameters.name: task_ids
